toolchain.source_execution: Clack source is parsed, verified, and compiled; it is not evaluated as Python.

commands.name: run
commands.result: verify, compile, execute, remove temporary executable

commands.name: emit-c
commands.result: verified C11 source; standard output if no destination is supplied

command_behavior.proof_artifact_kind: replayable verification conditions, not independently checked certificates
command_behavior.run_exit_behavior: propagates the native process status; signals use 128 plus signal number

syntax.indentation: spaces; tabs in indentation are rejected
syntax.identifiers: ASCII letters, digits, and underscore; first character cannot be a digit
syntax.integer_literals: decimal integers; no hexadecimal, underscores, or floating-point literals
syntax.text_literals: double-quoted JSON-style escapes; valid UTF-8 without NUL

text.representation: immutable UTF-8 originating in static literals
text.equality: exact byte equality; case-sensitive; no normalization

fixed_array.runtime_index_checks: indices must be proved in bounds before emission

operators.remainder: a nonzero remainder has the dividend's sign

builtins.name: print
builtins.restriction: main only; unit result; appends a newline

builtins.name: len
builtins.result: int; array element count or UTF-8 byte count

std.array.fill_shape_rule: count must be an integer literal from 1 through 1000000; value must be int or bool
std.array.sum_safety_rule: every left-to-right partial addition must fit signed 64-bit range

verification.executable_integer_arithmetic: all intermediates must fit signed 64-bit range
verification.proof_integer_arithmetic: mathematical integers; division and indexing still must be defined

annotation_rules.ensures: proved on every return; result denotes a non-unit returned value
annotation_rules.assert: proved from current facts; never an assumption
annotation_rules.invariant: proved on entry and preserved by continuing iterations
annotation_rules.decreases: integer measure nonnegative on active iterations and strictly decreasing

query_results.unsat: negated obligation has no counterexample in the model
query_results.sat: reject with a counterexample in the current path/specification model

limits: SMT exports are not independently checked proof certificates

for.index_scope: body only; cannot shadow an existing binding
for.additional_state: user invariants may be needed for changing accumulators and postconditions

while.verification_state: modified values are replaced at an arbitrary loop head and constrained by invariants

parallelism.data_exchange: values; no shared mutable language references
parallelism.execution: first N-1 jobs on POSIX threads, final job on caller

imports.local_resolution: relative to the importing source file's directory
imports.standard_namespace: std resolves only inside the installed bundled standard library

native_boundary.source_paths: relative .c files confined to the declaring module directory
native_boundary.call_location: main only; direct assignment or standalone unit call
native_boundary.native_result_model: fresh arbitrary int or bool result; unit has no assignable value

unsupported: arrays of text, records, or arrays
range steps or range values outside for headers
built-in file, network, random, clock, command-line argument, or console input APIs
repair_workflow: Read the diagnostic's original source path and line, including imported modules.
Establish required numeric/index/callee bounds through intended preconditions or guards.
Describe relations among modified loop state with useful invariants.
Do not use assert as an assumption or accept unknown results.
Preserve intended behavior when changing specifications.
Run documented demos and independent native-output checks after verification.
